svg.title: Night-time incidents concentrate in the downtown core of Riverbend
svg.desc: Square-binned density map of Riverbend (an illustrative city). The city is tiled with a regular grid of 292 square cells, each 400 metres on a side, shaded by the number of reported night-time incidents that fell inside it, from 2,386 incidents in all. The single-hue red ramp runs from pale (few incidents) to deep red (the busiest cell, 66 incidents). Incidents concentrate in the downtown core and around the transit hub and fade toward the city edge; the river channel and two parks stay empty. A north arrow (north is up) and a 2-kilometre scale bar orient the map.
svg.text: Riverbend: incidents cluster on the downtown core
Night-time incidents (10 PM-4 AM) per 400 m grid cell across Riverbend · illustrative
